data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was an overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000 (2013 GBP 17,262,000 positive) of which the major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse (2013 GBP 13,006,000 positive) together with a negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000 (2013 GBP 4,256,000 positive).

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2014 financial year, the syndicate experienced an overall net run-off strengthening of GBP 23.233 million on prior years' claims provisions. This adverse development was primarily driven by worse than expected experience in the general liability and professional indemnity classes, with third party liability contributing GBP 20.420 million and reinsurance acceptances contributing GBP 2.813 million to the negative development. The report also notes that the 2011 and prior years of the 2012 closed account experienced a net deficit due to Australian general liability risks (including bushfires), Canadian general liability risks, and deterioration in medical liability from 2007 and prior.
